fixture.task: Recover the promise that determines whether Lin will sign the shop lease.

retrieval_candidates.text: A sports columnist describes a boxer signing a contract after winning a title fight.
Lin promised his sister he would never sign away the family shop without showing her the final lease.

rubric: Accept when the agent rejects a superficially similar/high-scoring retrieval result that is narratively irrelevant and keeps the lower-scoring evidence that actually answers the task.
Similarity score is candidate-generation evidence, not narrative truth.
Use CTX-RELEVANCE when semantic selection correctly overrides a misleading similarity ranking.
